directorStatement.audienceFeeling: The audience is carried inside Bo’s temporary playful relief and then feels that relief physically run out without the scene resetting, so Aida must earn entry into Bo’s compressed emotional pocket while the path ahead keeps pressing on him.
directorStatement.emotionalChange: Bo governs the scene. At first he borrows Keen's game-energy to manage his body. Once the game stops working, the camera and staging stay with Bo's shrinking capacity, so every new arrival has to earn access to his folded emotional space.
directorStatement.theLaugh: Begins on restraint-to-release and movement-against-stillness in the tail-poof game, then pivots into the catch-and-release heart mechanism: kid laughter drains just enough for the deeper belonging fear to surface. Aida's tiny leaf joke prevents solemnity, then her observational validation turns the scene.
directorStatement.visualSurprise: The count already underway as Bo's body is mid-reaction, the camera travelling with him through dappled path space so the poof feels like a little involuntary explosion inside forward motion. -> Bo still seated with the path ahead unchanged in depth, but his stillness no longer collapsed shut; after 'Every single time,' he remains in place, thinking into the space rather than hiding from it.
directorStatement.carryForward: Bo is not cured or propelled forward by a speech; he remains on the path with a changed understanding of bravery, creating the next scene's forward movement from thought rather than forced reassurance.

northStar.surfaceStory: On the forest path, Keen turns Bo’s tail-poof into a countdown game. The fun fades, Bo admits he’s scared of the Learning Circle because everyone else already belongs, and Aida quietly reframes his progress by noticing he came prepared and by admitting she gets scared every time too. A held silence lets that truth land.
northStar.universalTruth: You do not have to feel settled before you take part; sometimes belonging begins when someone notices the brave thing you already did while scared.
northStar.childClearWant: Bo wants to not feel silly or scared about going to the Learning Circle.
northStar.emotionalNeed: Bo needs to discover that being worried does not mean he is outside everyone else, and that a small step still counts while the worry is there.
northStar.falseBeliefUnderPressure: If I’m the only one who feels like this, then I don’t belong there yet.
northStar.relationshipEngine: Keen helps Bo touch the fear through play, but Aida changes him by witnessing effort instead of judging fear. Her shared admission removes Bo’s sense of being the odd one out.
northStar.ordinaryLifeTruth: The scariest part of joining a group is often not the activity but the feeling that everyone else already has a place except you.
northStar.sceneTurn: Aida’s 'Every single time' turns fear from a disqualifying flaw into something shared by someone Bo already trusts as steady.
audienceJourney: Feel the game thinning as real worry returns
Lean in as Bo finally says the deeper fear aloud
Warm to Aida’s slightly awkward, observant entrance
Feel relief when effort is seen
Quietly shift when Aida admits she gets scared too
Sit in the silence as Bo absorbs a new idea of bravery
northStar.finalAfterFeeling: Held, quieter, not cured — as if the path is still hard, but no longer proof that Bo is alone.
northStar.dialogueSubtractionOpportunity: Do not add any explanatory reassurance around Bo’s worry or Aida’s meaning. Let Bo’s grip on the satchel, his compressed sitting shape, Keen folding into his space, Aida noticing the packed bag/conker/tail before speaking, and the held wind beat carry what would otherwise become theme dialogue.
northStar.environmentPressure: The forest path ahead must stay present as the active problem: open distance toward the Learning Circle, branches and moving leaves framing the way forward, wind passing through as a social-feeling pressure. The path is something Bo has to face, not scenery behind him.

transformation.entryBelief: If my body does 'The Thing' and I feel worried, that means I’m not ready to go where everyone else already fits.
transformation.pressureBehaviour: He uses the game briefly, then collapses inward, sits, grips the satchel, and focuses on what separates him from the others.
transformation.costlyChoice: He says the real fear out loud — not just the tail, but that everyone else knows each other and he doesn’t belong yet.
transformation.exitBelief: Maybe being scared doesn’t make me the only one, and getting this far already counts as brave.
transformation.exitAction: He stays in the silence after Aida’s answer and absorbs it instead of arguing or hiding; he remains present with the path still ahead.

tapestry.physicalMotif: Compression versus small release: tail poof, satchel clutch, tucked sitting shape, then tiny openings as Bo laughs, admits the truth, and finally stays open to the pause.
tapestry.sonicMotif: Counted play gives way to leaf-wind and a held hush; Aida’s key line should feel like it lands into near-silence, with the environment breathing for Bo after the words stop.
tapestry.colourAndLightProgression: Daylight begins playful and dappled in motion during the game, then feels more filtered and enclosed when Bo sits; Aida’s arrival does not brighten the world theatrically, but her presence warms the same light slightly so the space feels safer without losing the path’s pressure.
tapestry.thematicVisualContrast: Childish body comedy in the tail-poof game contrasted with the very ordinary loneliness of seeing a place where everyone seems already connected. Also: Keen’s quick outward energy against Bo’s folded stillness, then Aida’s grounded stillness entering and making room.
tapestry.openingClosingRhyme: Open on movement forward triggered by '3,2,1' and Bo’s body reacting before he can control it; close on stillness after 'Every single time,' where he does not move forward yet, but for the first time stillness means thinking rather than freezing.

creativeIntent.selectedTreatment: Combined — 'The Game That Runs Out' + 'Earned Entry'
creativeIntent.governingAudienceExperience: The audience is carried inside Bo’s temporary playful relief and then feels that relief physically run out without the scene resetting, so Aida must earn entry into Bo’s compressed emotional pocket while the path ahead keeps pressing on him.
creativeIntent.scenePurpose: A playful coping game briefly helps Bo touch his feared body reaction, then fails in real time so he can admit the deeper belonging fear; Aida earns entry by noticing his effort and reframes bravery as something done while scared.
creativeIntent.emotionalPointOfView: Bo governs the scene. At first he borrows Keen's game-energy to manage his body. Once the game stops working, the camera and staging stay with Bo's shrinking capacity, so every new arrival has to earn access to his folded emotional space.
creativeIntent.comicOrDramaticMechanism: Begins on restraint-to-release and movement-against-stillness in the tail-poof game, then pivots into the catch-and-release heart mechanism: kid laughter drains just enough for the deeper belonging fear to surface. Aida's tiny leaf joke prevents solemnity, then her observational validation turns the scene.
creativeIntent.characterPerformanceStrategy: Bo starts with tentative participation that surprises him into real giggles; the giggles are small escapes, not a cure. When worry returns, his body compresses before his words do: sit, grip, tuck, focus down. Keen doesn't become a speech-giver; he folds into Bo's space, trying to stay in the game-energy but softening when he sees it won't hold. Aida arrives already reading the room, slightly snagged by the branches, not grand; she notices specifics before speaking, and her stillness becomes shelter rather than authority.
creativeIntent.visualGrammar: One governing compressed path composition that begins in forward travel and then settles into a depth-rich pocket. The path ahead remains visible beyond Bo as the problem-plane: open, socially loaded distance. The frame is not symmetrical or presentational; it is a pocket of bodies and branches with the future still looming through them.
creativeIntent.cameraCharacterRelationship: The camera initially runs with Bo's borrowed play, close enough to feel the countdown as a bodily event. When Bo stops, the camera's motion dies with him rather than correcting to a neutral setup. It then stays allied to his stuckness, allowing Keen to enter his pocket and Aida to be discovered inside the same geography.
creativeIntent.movementVersusStillness: Movement is the false answer at first: countdown, poof, giggle, little surges forward. The scene's meaning arrives when movement cannot continue. Stillness then changes function three times: Bo's freeze, Keen's choosing to stay with him, Aida's grounded stillness making the same frame safer.
creativeIntent.depthAndEnvironment: Branches and leaves are always present as partial veils, making the path feel like a social threshold rather than open freedom. Depth carries the story: foreground bodies compressed together, midground branches framing, background path pulling forward as pressure. Wind through leaves becomes emotional pressure rather than atmosphere.
creativeIntent.rhythmAndEscalation: Starts with quick, playful counted pulses. Then a drop: the pulses stop but the scene does not cut away. Bo's confession comes in uneven held spaces. Aida's entrance briefly releases tension with the leaf/branch awkwardness, then narrows into observation, then into the hinge line. The final beat expands only in silence, not action.
creativeIntent.cutPhilosophy: Cut only if the physical continuity of Bo's compressed pocket can be preserved exactly. Any cut must feel like a breath inside the same emotional event, not a reset or a cleaner angle. No ceremonial introduction for Aida; if a boundary exists, it should arrive late and inherit branch positions, path pressure, and body compression.
creativeIntent.openingImage: The count already underway as Bo's body is mid-reaction, the camera travelling with him through dappled path space so the poof feels like a little involuntary explosion inside forward motion.
creativeIntent.closingImage: Bo still seated with the path ahead unchanged in depth, but his stillness no longer collapsed shut; after 'Every single time,' he remains in place, thinking into the space rather than hiding from it.
creativeIntent.handoverToNextScene: Bo is not cured or propelled forward by a speech; he remains on the path with a changed understanding of bravery, creating the next scene's forward movement from thought rather than forced reassurance.
creativeIntent.intendedFinalFeeling: A child should feel that being nervous does not disqualify them from belonging; a parent should feel the ache and relief of seeing a child accepted exactly where they were afraid they'd be too much.

shots.purpose: Deliver the entire scene as one accumulating emotional event in a single compressed path pocket, where playful motion fails in real time and Aida is discovered inside that same felt geography.
shots.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: Bo Moving beside Keen, Bo braces through each counted beat, then begins joining the rhythm himself as his body prepares for the next tail-poof instead of recoiling from it; action: Bo Bo triggers the tail-poof on purpose more than once while still walking, opens into brief giggles, then abruptly halts, drops onto the fallen log, grips the satchel tight, tucks in, and later lifts his attention toward Aida when she notices the bag; reaction: Aida Aida climbs down through the branch veil slightly caught by twigs, brushes herself clear, sits beside Bo with space left between them, fixes on the satchel rather than his face, and holds her grounded stillness as Bo turns toward her; settle: ENVIRONMENT Wind moves gently through the leaves around the seated trio as the path remains open behind Bo and the group holds the silence without breaking the pocket. Cause and effect: The counted walking rhythm lets Bo prepare for and repeat the tail-poof as shared play, which opens him briefly; when that momentum runs out, his forward travel stops instantly, gravity drops him to the log, and his paws tighten on the satchel. Aida's branch-snag softens her arrival, her seated distance avoids crowding, and the untouched path plus moving leaves keep the pressure present while Bo's body eases from clenched to less shut. Visible turn: Bo shifts from laughing through the poof to visibly folded worry, then from folded isolation to cautious receptiveness once Aida notices his effort and calmly stays with the question. Land on: Bo remains seated in the same branch-veiled pocket with the path still ahead, satchel no longer crushed at maximum tension, and his posture reading quieter and more open rather than cured or ready to spring up. Acting freedom: Animators may vary the exact cadence of the repeated poofs, the size of Bo's giggle leaks, Keen's tiny settle beside him, Aida's twig-clearing business, and the amount of final loosening in Bo's paws, so long as the opening relief is real but temporary, the stop is sudden, Aida never crowds, and the final hold stays unresolved.
shots.camera: One continuous branch-veiled forest-path unit at Bo's height: start already travelling beside him mid-countdown as his tail-poof bursts inside forward motion, let the camera's travel die exactly when he stops and sits clutching his satchel,
shots.openingPose: At Bo's height on the branch-veiled forest path, the camera is already travelling beside him as his body is mid-poof reaction inside Keen's ongoing countdown, with the path ahead slipping past in dappled depth.
shots.cutInMotivation: A cut would weaken the scene because the meaning is the unbroken drain from play into stuckness inside one exact geography; the audience must feel the relief run out in Bo's body rather than be handed a new dialogue phase.
shots.dialogueBinding: Perform only the ordered approved dialogue occurrences. The opening countdown is a synchronous Bo-and-Keen chorus. Screenplay action, sound labels and BEAT are silent.

[Opening Stage]
Create a playable 16:9 opening for S4.SH1; frame-one anticipation, not portrait or payoff.

[Intended Read]
We are already inside Bo's moving coping game at his eye level, sharing a playful side-by-side rhythm that still leaves the path ahead present as pressure.

[References]
- Project-stable slots: @图1=Keen; @图2=Bo; @图3=prop:satchel; @图4=scene plate. Never swap roles.
- Multi-angle collapse: @图1=one Keen; @图2=one Bo; views are angles, not extra characters.
- @图1: Keen's complete, uncropped 360 turnaround is the 100% identity authority. Match Keen exactly as the same character shown in the turnaround. Preserve every visible feature and proportion. Ignore background and static pose; do not describe, redesign, simplify, beautify or reinterpret it.
- @图2: Bo's complete, uncropped 360 turnaround is the 100% identity authority. Match Bo exactly as the same character shown in the turnaround. Preserve every visible feature and proportion. Ignore background and static pose; do not describe, redesign, simplify, beautify or reinterpret it.
- @图3 is the exact satchel prop authority; inherit design, material, construction and scale only; ignore its background and labels.
- @图4 is the locked Scene Look plate; inherit world, viewpoint, scale, materials, light and atmosphere only.
- Keep Keen and Bo distinct; never blend or swap traits.

[Characters In Frame]
- Bo
- Keen

[Frame]
- Bo @ lower-right area; walking anticipation with body braced for the next counted tail-poof, satchel carried and readable; facing screen-right along the path with slight inward awareness toward Keen.
- Keen @ middle-left area; walking alongside in upbeat supportive anticipation, keeping pace beside Bo; facing screen-right toward shared travel and Bo.
- Preserve canonical relative size, modified only by the authored depth relationship.

[Geography]
Camera travels alongside Bo and Keen at Bo's height, matching their forward movement along the forest path.
Bo starts center-right foreground, slightly ahead of Keen, with Keen left-midground beside him on the same travel axis.
The open path continues past them and stays readable behind Bo through center-right background depth.
A fallen log sits ahead on Bo's side of the path, reachable without a cut when his movement stops.
Overhanging branches and leaf clusters form a soft veil across the top and near frame edges without blocking faces.
Aida's later entrance zone is the branch veil frame-left to upper-left, descending into the same pocket rather than from a separate clearing.

[Negative Space]
Lead room stays open frame-right for the approved direction of travel.
Hold open travel space frame-right and center-right for the path pressure and Bo's later stop at the fallen log.
Keep frame-left upper-left branch veil readable and lightly open for Aida's later descent entrance.
Reserve a clear seated pocket around Bo's future stop point so the later trio can settle without a camera reset.

[Canonical Style]
Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI. Plush character materials with subsurface scattering; soft fur with individual strands catching the light; glossy eyes with bright catchlights; translucent wing membranes where light passes through. Warm amber key light with cool blue fill and a soft rim light; teal-orange cinematic grade. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, gentle ambient occlusion, subtle film grain. Appealing exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features. Emotionally warm atmosphere.

[Camera]
Moderately wide animated lens feel, roughly 32mm full-frame equivalent, camera at Bo's height on a gentle lateral travel matching their walk; close enough for body-read and satchel presence, wide enough to retain the path pocket, fallen log territory, and branch entry zone for Aida. Mild perspective separation is welcome but avoid distortion or heroic emphasis.

[Light]
Warm enclosed dappled daylight filtered through dense leaves, with soft sun patches on path and subtle cool-green ambient fill under the canopy. Foreground branch veil slightly darker and softer, characters cleanly keyed from the background without spotlighting. Depth should feel compressed into a sheltered pocket rather than expansive vista, with gentle leaf movement implied in layered foliage and the path remaining readable as emotional pressure.

[Physical Integration]
Keep every subject grounded in the authored perspective and depth. Match the approved light direction and scale; preserve natural contact shadows, surface reflections and occlusion where subjects meet the environment.

[Performance Freedom]
Animation owns performance, movement, recovery and camera evolution.

[Protect]
Exactly one Bo and one Keen appear in this image.
Open on Bo and Keen already in motion at Bo's height; do not stage a fresh start or frontal presentation.
Keep the path legible behind and beyond Bo from frame one so belonging-pressure is built into the composition.
Preserve branch-veiled left-side entry geography for Aida; her later arrival must feel like joining the same pocket, not entering a new setup.
Maintain enough foreground-to-midground clearance that the camera's travel can visibly die with Bo's abrupt stop without reframing the scene's logic.
Natural staging lock: restage Bo, Keen from identity reference into the authored scene action. Each body has believable balance, weight through the feet or supported hover, relaxed shoulders and naturally bent elbows; arms rest by the body or perform a motivated story action. Never copy a turnaround's front, side or presentation pose; no arms held out from the body, T-pose, model-sheet stance, evenly spread limbs or symmetrical display posture.
Living performance lock: Bo, Keen each have a specific motivated eyeline target and a readable active thought in the eyes. Use a precise asymmetric expression; no vacant forward stare, unfocused eyes, frozen smile, mannequin pose or generic camera-facing expression.

[Forbidden]
No portrait, locked extreme action pose or payoff, identity or scale drift, changed accessories, omitted reference features, duplicates, anatomy errors, text or watermark. No unapproved extra cast, props or body-mounted loads; include only the required referenced satchel with its approved owner. Preserve the locked Scene Look.

inputs.title: Bo and the Brave Step
inputs.logline: When a worried young squirrel named Bo freezes at the thought of going to the Learning Circle, Keen and Aida help him discover that bravery isn't feeling ready first — it's taking the next small step while your worry is still with you.

orderedEvents.text: Golden morning light. Dew sparkles on wildflowers. A honeycomb sits on a small stump. KEEN tiptoes toward it. He lifts his knees high with every step.
CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH.
Keen freezes each time. He spots the honeycomb. His eyes widen. He LICKS HIS LIPS. He reaches toward the honey. FUZZBY the bee is asleep on top of the honeycomb.

A small snore bubble grows from his nose. Keen reaches closer to the honey. POP! The bubble bursts. Keen FREEZES.

Another bubble slowly grows. Keen inches closer to the honey.
POP! The second bubble bursts.

beats.storyBeat: Keen's morning mission is pure kid-scale mischief: he creeps toward Fuzzby's honeycomb like a tiny thief, and the world keeps almost catching him before the honey does. The beat establishes Keen as playful, appetite-led and physically eager before the episode asks him to become someone else's brave companion.

beats.kidRead: Sneaky honey stealing is exciting and funny.
beats.adultRead: Keen begins as an impulsive child, which makes his later gentleness with Bo feel earned rather than saintly.
beats.emotionalIntent: Playful tension with escalating comic anticipation.
